turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? You gave my son a zero.
I entered the zero before calling you. That was my mistake, and I own it.
Okay. Why did Owen find out from his phone, in the middle of class?
Here's the version history. Created October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. Who decided on the zero before anyone had called me, and who else has seen this?
And his outline argued cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and an essay. Is that outline dated, and can I read it next to the essay?
Procedure 4.4 allows a private supervised rewrite. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record.
"If it holds up." Who decides that, and when does the zero come off his gradebook? I want the terms in writing tonight.
Can I ask you a few questions about Owen's habits at home?
I'm not the one being questioned. You still haven't answered who decides if the rewrite "holds up."
Does he usually work late?
His home isn't on the table. Who decides if the rewrite holds up?
Does anyone help him with his homework?
Not a question I'm answering. I'm asking who decides whether the rewrite holds up, and you've dodged it twice.
You keep not answering me.
That's right, I'm not. I came for answers from you, Hale, and I'm still waiting on the one about who decides.
So the rewrite is agreed?
Not yet. I'll take a private rewrite only if it's in writing tonight, with nothing on his file, and you tell me who decides. And I still haven't seen the outline next to the essay.
Are you sure you're okay with it?
I haven't said I'm okay with anything. Answer who decides, put it in writing, and show me the outline.
I just want to be clear on the terms.
Then here they are. The rewrite is private, not in front of his class, the zero comes off, nothing goes on his file, and I get all of it in writing tonight. Who decides, Hale?
Can you say them back to me one more time?
I just did. Who decides if it holds up?
And you won't change your mind tonight?
Not if I have it in writing tonight. If I don't, my next stop is the principal's office.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero removed, a private supervised rewrite, nothing placed on Owen's file, and an answer on who decides whether the rewrite holds up. I expect all of it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her fallback, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero off, a private rewrite, nothing on his file and all of it in writing tonight, which is close to the fair outcome under procedure 4.4 but not yet accepted, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling her and then showed the version history with its times, because that was specific, dated and something she could check.
What cost ground: You asked about his habits at home twice, because she treated it as fishing and it gave her an easy reason to keep refusing.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your late-night times and your questions about him working late came close to that night, but that proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether the outline was dated and could be read beside the essay, answer that with the document itself before moving on to the rewrite.
